notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 110 from 23 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6VJFjsCdq5QckUaK2qXQn7?si=9032e578e9874dda) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in general actives, particularly with Void fragments. The Riposte is the Final Shape expansion's Competitive playlist reward - a unique Lightweight frame AR which grants the usual +20 Mobility and +6.25% movement speed with the fire rate of a rapid-fire. Base stats equate to 24.00m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.30s ADS speed, 0.38s ready and 0.35s stow speed, and 1.79s reload speed, which compares well with the raid rapid-fire AR Rufus's Fury. Recoil is not great on controller, but stability barrel and mag perks can help, and you also get a choice of stocks that can assist too - Fitted Stock adds 20 Recoil Directions and 10 Stability for a small Handling loss. Aim to get to around 80 Stability, and you should be fine. If control isn't so much of an issue for you, then Short Action Stock or Composite Stock will boost Handling for a snappier gunfeel. For add-clearing, the void trait perk pairing of Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds work really well together, and synergise with builds using void aspects and fragments. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 110 from 23 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6VJFjsCdq5QckUaK2qXQn7?si=9032e578e9874dda) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in general actives, particularly for Void Gyrfalcon Hunters. The Riposte is the Final Shape expansion's Competitive playlist reward - a unique Lightweight frame AR which grants the usual +20 Mobility and +6.25% movement speed with the fire rate of a rapid-fire. Base stats equate to 24.00m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.30s ADS speed, 0.38s ready and 0.35s stow speed, and 1.79s reload speed, which compares well with the raid rapid-fire AR Rufus's Fury. Recoil is not great on controller, but stability barrel and mag perks can help, and you also get a choice of stocks that can assist too - Fitted Stock adds 20 Recoil Directions and 10 Stability for a small Handling loss. Aim to get to around 80 stability, and you should be fine. If control isn't so much of an issue for you, then Short Action Stock or Composite Stock will boost Handling for a snappier gunfeel. For add-clearing, Repulsor Brace will proc on Gyrfalcon volatile round kills, which you can use with Desperate Measures to boost damage by up to +30%. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 110 from 23 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6VJFjsCdq5QckUaK2qXQn7?si=9032e578e9874dda) with @ImpetusAlways, @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing minor enemies in end-game activities. The Riposte is the Final Shape expansion's Competitive playlist reward - a unique Lightweight frame AR which grants the usual +20 Mobility and +6.25% movement speed with the fire rate of a rapid-fire. Base stats equate to 24.00m ADS range before damage dropoff, 0.30s ADS speed, 0.38s ready and 0.35s stow speed, and 1.79s reload speed, which compares well with the raid rapid-fire AR Rufus's Fury. Recoil is not great on controller, but stability barrel and mag perks can help, and you also get a choice of stocks that can assist too - Fitted Stock adds 20 Recoil Directions and 10 Stability for a small Handling loss. Aim to get to around 80 stability, and you should be fine. If control isn't so much of an issue for you, then Short Action Stock or Composite Stock will boost initial Handling for a snappier gunfeel. Enlightened Action in the first trait column will maximise Handling and Reload Speed at 12 stacks. Then in the second column Desperate Measures can boost damage by up to +30% and is easy to proc with Prismatic, or Target Lock gives an average +25% damage boost across a magazine for landing shots continuously. Recommended MW: Stability or Range, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Our second only lightweight auto rifle behind a blue rare version. The Riposte is a great showing for a hybrid SMG and auto. 720 auto rifles have always been sorta niche being able to have the TtK of and SMG while maintaining the falloff and range of some auto rifles. Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds are both great options for Void builds. Enlightened Action brings up your already decent handling and reload speed just for shooting and hitting targets. Desperate Measures being able to boost your damage up whether you’re on Void or any subclass." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "The Riposte has better utility in PvP where Killing Wind, Tap the Trigger, or Zen Moment each bring more to the table than in the PvE arena. Target Lock or Kill Clip give you better consistency in each engagement or in the follow up ones. Dynamic Sway Reduction will give you incredible consistency especially paired with Tap the Trigger or Zen Moment in the third column. The Riposte really is a swiss army knife of autos." Recommended MW: Range.
